question: Should the bundled Comfy plugin make 16 MiB a supported hard limit for existing configured workflow files, or should it preserve currently valid larger workflows through a different compatibility-safe bound?
rationale: The code change is mechanically narrow, but choosing a hard size limit changes existing configuration behavior and no repository contract in the supplied evidence establishes that 16 MiB is safe for all current users.

options.title: Define and prove the supported limit
options.body: Keep a bounded reader, but select an approved limit and add user-facing documentation plus fresh-install and upgrade coverage for the resulting failure behavior.

options.title: Accept the 16 MiB break
options.body: Merge the current boundary as an intentional compatibility change, with maintainers explicitly accepting that larger existing workflows must be reduced or restructured.

options.title: Pause for a compatibility-safe design
options.body: Hold this PR if a stable limit and actionable upgrade story cannot be defined without adding an unwanted new configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Define and prove the supported limit
recommendation.body: Keep a bounded reader, but select an approved limit and add user-facing documentation plus fresh-install and upgrade coverage for the resulting failure behavior.
